blocks.text: than: older than, more expensive than

O'zbek tilida taqqoslanayotgan narsaga `-dan` qo'shimchasi qo'shiladi: Akam **mendan** katta, Poyezd **avtobusdan** tezroq. Ingliz tilida esa qiyosiy darajadan (87-dars) keyin **than** so'zi, undan keyin taqqoslanayotgan narsa keladi: My brother is **older than** me. Farqi — tartibda: o'zbekchada `-dan` so'zning **oxiriga** qo'shiladi, inglizchada **than** so'zning **oldida** alohida turadi. Yana bir farq: o'zbekchada `-dan` bo'lsa, `-roq` ko'pincha tushib qoladi («mendan katta»), inglizchada esa qiyosiy shakl shart: «older», «old» emas.

rows: The train is **faster than** the bus.
This book is **more interesting than** that one.

blocks.text: than me yoki than I am

**than** dan keyin olmosh kelsa, so'zlashuvda obyekt shakli ishlatiladi: than **me**, than **him**, than **her**, than **us**, than **them** (59-dars). Ikkinchi yo'l — ega + yordamchi fe'l: than **I am**, than **he does**, than **we did**, than **they have**. Yordamchi fe'l gapdagi zamonga mos keladi: He runs faster than I **do** (Present Simple), She worked harder than he **did** (Past Simple). Yolg'iz «than I» juda rasmiy eshitiladi — kundalik nutqda **than me** yoki **than I am** deng.

items.text: My sister is two years **older than me**.
Aziz plays chess **better than I do**.

blocks.text: than usual, than before, than I thought

**than** dan keyin faqat ot yoki olmosh emas, butun ibora yoki gap ham kelishi mumkin. Eng ko'p ishlatiladiganlari: **than usual** — odatdagidan, **than before** — avvalgidan, **than last year** — o'tgan yilgidan, **than I thought** — o'ylaganimdan, **than we expected** — kutganimizdan. O'zbekchada bularning hammasi `-dan` bilan aytiladi: o'ylagan**imdan**, odatdagi**dan**.

**more than** + son — «...dan ortiq, ...dan ko'p»: **more than** 100 people — yuzdan ortiq odam. **less than** — «...dan kam»: **less than** an hour — bir soatdan kam. **less** — **more** ning teskarisi, sifat bilan ham keladi: **less expensive than** = cheaper than (arzonroq). Sanalmaydigan ot bilan **less** (less sugar, less time), sanaladigan ko'plik ot bilan esa **fewer** ishlatiladi (fewer people — 84-dars).

rows: **less than** ten minutes — o'n daqiqadan kam

items.text: **More than** fifty guests came to the wedding.
The film lasted **less than** ninety minutes.

blocks.text: much, a lot, far, a bit, a little + qiyosiy daraja

Farq qanchalik katta ekanini aytish uchun o'zbekchada «ancha», «ko'p», «sal», «biroz» ishlatiladi: **ancha** qimmatroq, **sal** arzonroq. Ingliz tilida qiyosiy darajadan oldin: **much / a lot / far** — katta farq («ancha», «ko'p»), **a bit / a little** — kichik farq («biroz», «sal»). Bu so'zlar **more** bilan ham ishlaydi: **much more** expensive, **a bit more** slowly. **very** esa qiyosiy darajadan oldin qo'yilmaydi: «very cheaper» — xato, **much cheaper** — to'g'ri. very faqat oddiy sifat bilan: **very** cheap.

items.text: The new phone is **much faster** than my old one.
Could you walk **a bit more slowly**?
Life in the village is **far quieter** than in the city.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «older from me» → **older than** me (`-dan` ni «from» deb tarjima qilmang); «Uzbekistan is bigger Tajikistan» → bigger **than** Tajikistan (than tushib qolmasin); «He is old than me» → **older** than me (qiyosiy shakl shart); «very cheaper» → **much cheaper**; «more bigger» → **bigger**; «then me» → **than** me (then — «keyin, o'shanda»).
**than** va **then** ni adashtirmang: th**a**n — taqqoslash (-dan), th**e**n — vaqt (keyin, o'shanda). Eslab qolish: comp**a**re — th**a**n.
Bog'lanish: qiyosiy shakllar (older, more expensive, better) — 87-dars; teng yoki teng emasligini aytish: as old as, not as expensive as — 89-dars; eng ... (the oldest) — 90-dars.

items: qiyosiy daraja + **than** + narsa: Tashkent is **bigger than** Samarkand;
olmosh: than **me / him / us** yoki than **I am / he does / we did**;
than + ibora: **than usual**, **than before**, **than I thought**;
son bilan: **more than** 100, **less than** an hour;
katta farq: **much / a lot / far** + qiyosiy; kichik farq: **a bit / a little** + qiyosiy; **very** + qiyosiy — xato.

examples.title: **older than**, **cheaper than**
examples.description: Qiyosiy daraja + **than** + taqqoslanayotgan narsa. O'zbekchada `-dan` qo'shimchasi: Samarkand is **older than** Tashkent — Samarqand **Toshkentdan qadimiyroq**.

sentences.text: Samarkand is **older than** Tashkent.
The train is **faster than** the bus, and it's more comfortable.
Mount Everest is **higher than** any mountain in Europe.
sentences.translation: Everest tog'i Yevropadagi **har qanday tog'dan baland**.

sentences.text: My brother is three years **younger than** my sister.
Is London **bigger than** Paris?
Apples are **cheaper than** bananas in autumn.
In summer Bukhara is often **hotter than** Tashkent.
The Thames is **shorter than** the Volga, but it's very famous.
Dilnoza's new flat is **smaller than** her old one, but it's **closer** to her work.
sentences.translation: Dilnozaning yangi kvartirasi **eskisidan kichikroq**, lekin ishxonasiga **yaqinroq**.

sentences.text: Sending a message is **quicker than** writing a letter, but a letter is more personal.
sentences.translation: Xabar yuborish **xat yozishdan tezroq**, lekin xat samimiyroq.

examples.title: **more** ... **than**, **better than**, **worse than**
examples.description: Uzun sifatlar: **more expensive than**, **more interesting than**. Noto'g'ri shakllar ham **than** bilan: **better than**, **worse than**, **further than**.

sentences.text: A taxi is **more expensive than** the metro.
For me, history is **more interesting than** maths.
Your idea is **better than** mine.
The weather today is **worse than** yesterday.
Is Oxford **further** from London **than** Cambridge?
Learning a language online is **more convenient than** going to a school.
sentences.translation: Tilni onlayn o'rganish **maktabga qatnashdan ko'ra qulayroq**.

sentences.text: Bekzod's English is **better than** his brother's.
Nothing is **more important than** your health.
The second film was **more exciting than** the first, but the ending was **worse**.
sentences.translation: Ikkinchi film **birinchisidan qiziqarliroq** edi, lekin oxiri **yomonroq** chiqdi.

sentences.text: Living near your office is **more practical than** driving an hour every day.
sentences.translation: Ishxona yaqinida yashash har kuni bir soat mashina **haydashdan ko'ra qulayroq**.

examples.title: **than me** / **than I am** / **than we do**
examples.description: **than** dan keyin so'zlashuvda obyekt olmoshi: than **me**, than **him**, than **us**. Yoki ega + yordamchi fe'l: than **I am**, than **James does**, than **we have**.

sentences.text: My sister is **taller than me**.
You're a **better** cook **than I am**.
Emma works **longer** hours **than James does**, but he earns more.
sentences.translation: Emma **Jeymsdan ko'proq** soat ishlaydi, lekin Jeyms ko'proq maosh oladi.

sentences.text: Don't worry — they're **more nervous than us**.
sentences.translation: Xavotir olmang — ular **bizdan ham ko'proq** hayajonda.

sentences.text: Madina speaks French **better than I do**.
Our neighbours have lived here **longer than we have**.
sentences.translation: Qo'shnilarimiz bu yerda **bizdan uzoqroq** yashab kelishyapti.

sentences.text: Tom is fifteen, and his younger brother is already **taller than him**.
sentences.translation: Tom o'n besh yoshda, ukasi esa allaqachon **undan baland**.

sentences.text: Grandma remembers old songs **better than we do**.
Were the other students **younger than you**? — Yes, most of them were.
sentences.translation: Boshqa talabalar **sizdan yoshroq** edimi? — Ha, ko'pchiligi.

sentences.text: I thought Aziz was older, but actually he's a year **younger than I am**.
sentences.translation: Azizni katta deb o'ylagandim, aslida u **mendan** bir yosh **kichik** ekan.

examples.title: **than usual**, **than before**, **than I thought**
examples.description: **than** dan keyin ibora yoki gap ham keladi: **than usual** (odatdagidan), **than before** (avvalgidan), **than I thought** (o'ylaganimdan), **than we expected** (kutganimizdan).

sentences.text: The bus was **more crowded than usual** this morning.
The exam was **easier than I thought**.
Prices are **higher than last year**.
You look **healthier than before** — have you been doing sport?
Our flight took **longer than we expected**.
Our trip to Khiva was **more interesting than we hoped**.
sentences.translation: Xivaga safarimiz **umid qilganimizdan ham qiziqroq** o'tdi.

sentences.text: Today I got up **earlier than usual** because of the noise.
Emma is **busier than she was** last month.
Learning to drive was **harder than I expected**, but I passed the test.
sentences.translation: Mashina haydashni o'rganish **kutganimdan qiyinroq** ekan, lekin imtihondan o'tdim.

sentences.text: The house looks **smaller than it did** in the photos.

examples.title: **more than** / **less than**
examples.description: **more than** + son — «...dan ortiq», **less than** — «...dan kam». **less** — **more** ning teskarisi: **less expensive than** = cheaper than.

sentences.text: **More than** two thousand people came to the concert.
The journey takes **less than** an hour by train.
sentences.translation: Poyezdda yo'l **bir soatdan kam** vaqt oladi.

sentences.text: How much was your bike? Two hundred pounds? — No, **more than** that.
sentences.translation: Velosipedingiz qancha turdi? Ikki yuz funtmi? — Yo'q, **undan ko'proq**.

sentences.text: My grandfather has got **more than** twenty grandchildren.
This laptop is **less expensive than** the other one, and it's lighter too.
sentences.translation: Bu noutbuk **anavisidan arzonroq**, ustiga yengilroq ham.

sentences.text: I spend **less time** on my phone **than** my friends do.
Tom has **more** free time **than** his wife, so he does the shopping.
sentences.translation: Tomning **xotinidan ko'ra ko'proq** bo'sh vaqti bor, shuning uchun xaridni u qiladi.

sentences.text: There were **fewer than** ten students in the class today.
sentences.translation: Bugun sinfda **o'ntadan kam** talaba bor edi.

sentences.text: Is Bukhara **more than** five hundred kilometres from Tashkent? — Yes, nearly six hundred.
sentences.translation: Toshkentdan Buxorogacha **besh yuz kilometrdan ko'proqmi**? — Ha, deyarli olti yuz.

sentences.text: Dilnoza eats **less** sugar **than** before, and she feels much healthier.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza **avvalgidan kamroq** shakar iste'mol qiladi va o'zini ancha sog'lom his qiladi.

examples.title: **much** / **a lot** / **far** + comparative
examples.description: Farq katta bo'lsa — **much**, **a lot**, **far** («ancha», «ko'p»): **much cheaper**, **a lot bigger**, **far more expensive**. «very cheaper» deyilmaydi.

sentences.text: The new bridge is **much longer** than the old one.
London is **a lot more expensive** than Manchester.
Flying is **far quicker**, but the train is cheaper.
I feel **much better** today, thank you.
Your flat is **a lot nicer** than mine — it's got a balcony!
Is Tashkent **much bigger** than Samarkand? — Yes, about five times.
sentences.translation: Toshkent Samarqanddan **ancha kattami**? — Ha, taxminan besh barobar.

sentences.text: Mountain roads are **far more dangerous** in winter.
My new job is **much more interesting**, and the people are friendlier.
sentences.translation: Yangi ishim **ancha qiziqroq**, odamlari ham samimiyroq.

sentences.text: Bekzod's English is **far better** than mine, so let him do the talking.
sentences.translation: Bekzodning inglizchasi menikidan **beqiyos yaxshi**, shuning uchun gaplashishni unga qo'yib beraylik.

sentences.text: Prices at the airport are **a lot higher** than in the city.

examples.title: **a bit** / **a little** + comparative
examples.description: Farq kichik bo'lsa — **a bit**, **a little** («biroz», «sal»): **a bit older**, **a little warmer**. Savol → javob va inkor bilan: **isn't much taller** — only **a little**.

sentences.text: Can you move **a little closer**? I can't see you in the photo.
Is the hotel far? — No, it's only **a bit further** than the station.
Madina is **a little older** than her husband.
Today is **a bit warmer** than yesterday, but it's still cold.
sentences.translation: Bugun kechagidan **sal iliqroq**, lekin baribir sovuq.

sentences.text: This jacket is **a bit cheaper**, and I like the colour more.
sentences.translation: Bu kurtka **sal arzonroq**, rangi ham menga ko'proq yoqadi.

sentences.text: Was the test difficult? — Not really, just **a little harder** than the last one.
sentences.translation: Test qiyinmidi? — Unchalik emas, oldingisidan **biroz qiyinroq** edi, xolos.

sentences.text: Can we meet **a bit earlier**? I have to leave at six.
sentences.translation: **Sal ertaroq** uchrasha olamizmi? Soat oltida ketishim kerak.

sentences.text: The soup is good, but it could be **a little hotter**.
sentences.translation: Sho'rva yaxshi, lekin **sal issiqroq** bo'lsa bo'lardi.

sentences.text: James **isn't much taller** than Tom — only **a little**.
The second flat is **a bit more expensive**, but it's **much quieter** and **a lot closer** to the metro.
sentences.translation: Ikkinchi kvartira **biroz qimmatroq**, lekin **ancha tinch** va metroga **ancha yaqin**.

examples.title: Mixed: London and Tashkent
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: ikki shaharni taqqoslash — **than**, than **we do**, **more than** / **less than** va **much / a lot / a bit**.

sentences.text: London is **much bigger than** Tashkent, and it's **far more expensive**.
sentences.translation: London **Toshkentdan ancha katta**, narxlari ham **beqiyos qimmat**.

sentences.text: Summers in Tashkent are **a lot hotter than** in London.
But winters in London are **wetter**, and the days are **shorter than** in Uzbekistan.
sentences.translation: Lekin Londonda qish **namroq**, kunlar ham **O'zbekistondagidan qisqaroq**.

sentences.text: The London Underground is **more than** 150 years old.
A metro ticket in Tashkent costs **less than** a cup of coffee.
sentences.translation: Toshkentda metro chiptasi **bir piyola qahvadan ham arzon**.

sentences.text: My cousin lives in London, and she says people there walk **faster than** we do.
sentences.translation: Amakivachcham Londonda yashaydi, uning aytishicha, u yerda odamlar **bizdan tezroq** yurar ekan.

sentences.text: Is the food **better** in London **than** in Tashkent? — No way!
Flights between the two cities take **a bit more than** seven hours.
sentences.translation: Ikki shahar orasidagi parvoz **yetti soatdan sal ko'proq** davom etadi.

sentences.text: Life in London is **busier than** life in Tashkent, but it isn't **more interesting**.
In the end, home is always **better than** anywhere else.
sentences.translation: Nima bo'lganda ham, o'z uyimiz **hamma joydan yaxshi**.
